review_text: Absolutely incredible experience! The staff was attentive, the presentation was beautiful, and the flavors were outstanding. Will definitely be coming back with friends.
The service was completely unacceptable tonight. We waited over 45 minutes for our order, and when it finally arrived, it was completely cold. Nobody came to check on us.
Overall okay, but the seating area was quite cramped and noisy. Food quality was decent for the price point, but nothing spectacular.
WARNING: Do NOT eat here. My entire family developed severe food poisoning after consuming the seafood platter last night. Currently at the clinic. This place needs a health inspection immediately.

The manager on shift was incredibly hostile and used a highly offensive discriminatory slur when we asked to split our bill. I have video proof and will be contacting my legal team first thing in the morning.
